### Come to the Altar
Author: Arlene Pellicane
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-september-10-2021.html
Passage: Ezra 10:2
Points:
- Shecaniah modeled godly leadership by identifying with his people and openly confessing their corporate sin.
- He refused to ignore the spiritual compromise that had taken root within his family and nation.
- Sincere repentance meant moving beyond emotional sorrow into decisive and obedience-driven action.
- Even in the wake of grievous unfaithfulness, God leaves room for renewal and hope.
- Believers should regularly examine their own hearts to root out compromise and rekindle passion for God.
